name: PRYYSE Team · R1 + R3 refined (FOR REVIEW)
author: PRYYSE · coached proposal

1/they.Start: Hold the legal serve-receive shape until their serve contact. Harry P1 stands forward behind Georgia to be free for second contact; Caleb takes most deep seams.
1/they.Receive: Read flight and call MINE early: Caleb centre/deep right, Jaz deep left, Georgia shallow right, Trent/Logan short left/centre. Harry only takes an unavoidable short ball.
1/they.Set: Harry sets whichever first pass is playable; if Harry passed, Georgia takes second, with Caleb as reachability backup. Logan left, Trent middle, Georgia right when available.
1/they.Attack: Call the actual hitter and cover the rebound: Harry short middle, Jaz left and Caleb deeper; unused front attackers have a named tip/cover job.
1/they.Defend: Track their setter. Left/middle: Trent + Logan double block with Harry behind; right: Trent single if he can close, Logan releases to the short cut, and all floor lanes readjust.

1/us.Start: Harry serves from behind the endline. Five others remain TTGVA overlap-legal at service hit; no one moves before contact.
1/us.Defend: After serving Harry runs through a realistic right-side return lane, not directly to the net. Trent + Logan left/middle block; right Trent singles if early and Logan covers cut.
1/us.Receive: Actual digger takes the ball. Caleb owns deep middle and difficult seams; Jaz owns reachable left deep. Harry fields only a near/reachable ball and never sets his own dig.
1/us.Set: Harry normally moves to the ball to set after another player digs. Georgia sets if Harry took first and is close enough; Caleb is the alternative.
1/us.Attack: Left Logan and middle Trent are first options, Georgia right when she did not set. All others cover; recover into useful next defence, never to the serve-contact positions.

3/they.Start: Hold R3 legal service-contact positions: Caleb P4 left, Jaz P3 middle, Trent P2 right; Harry P5 back-left, Georgia P6 deep middle, Logan P1 deep right. No release before serve contact.
3/they.Receive: Georgia takes the example deep-centre serve; Caleb takes larger left/deep seams; Logan owns narrow deep-right, Jaz short-right, Trent short-right/front. Harry is NOT a routine passer; he only receives an unavoidable short/net-roll ball.
3/they.Set: After any non-Harry first touch, Harry runs directly to the playable set around (-0.65,0.83), NOT back to P5. If Harry has first contact, Georgia moves to that same target for the second, Caleb is emergency if closest.
3/they.Attack: Caleb hits the illustrated left-side attack; Trent stays a right/mid alternative and Jaz a controlled right-side option. Harry and the remaining three cover blocked rebounds and short/deep returns.
3/they.Defend: From the previous attack, Trent pre-shifts for a reachable single block on our left OR right. Caleb covers left/deep; Harry short-centre/left and prepares to set; Jaz short right; Georgia deep centre; Logan deep right. On a QUICK far-left set Trent cannot reach, Caleb may block if already close, while left floor coverage shifts; no magical rapid double.

3/us.Start: Logan P1 actually serves behind z=9, with all others in R3 legal service order. Everyone holds until service contact; nobody runs ahead.
3/us.Receive: After our serve, first team contact is a dig of their return. Georgia owns the normal deep-centre dig; Harry covers reachable left-short balls and is only first if the ball comes into his area. Logan returns to compact right-back.
3/us.Set: After Georgia or anyone else digs, Harry sets via the short left-centre lane around (-0.65,0.83). Harry-first dig: Georgia takes the second contact with Caleb emergency if nearer.
3/us.Attack: Caleb is the standard left hitter; Trent right/mid and Jaz controlled right alternative as timing allows. Others cover blocked hits; no forced reset to official starting places.
3/us.Defend: Trent pre-shifts during opponent three-touch play and singles a reachable side; Caleb deep-left, Harry short-left/centre and setter release, Jaz short-right, Georgia deep middle, Logan right-back. Very fast attacks may need the nearest local blocker or no block; do not demand Trent cover both antennas instantly. After second dig Caleb, Harry sets again.

harry.primary: Forward P1 behind Georgia: stay legally back until service hit, read but avoid normal first pass.
harry.ifDifferent: Very short net-roll at your feet: take it and call GEORGIA SET.

caleb.primary: Strong central/right deep passer. Call central seam early.
caleb.fallback: Let Jaz own the clearly left deep ball once she calls.

jaz.primary: Deep left with compact area. Face the serve and call your left seam.
jaz.fallback: Ask Caleb for distant centre/deep cross, do not sprint across court.

trent.primary: Protect short-left, then prepare the middle attack and main block.
trent.teamCall: Tell Logan when you switch toward middle.

logan.primary: Short centre-left initial cover, then open the left hitting lane.
logan.fallback: Let the closest front player receive short; do not steal Caleb's deep pass.

georgia.primary: Right short receive support, then real right-side hitter if not the first passer.
georgia.ifDifferent: If Harry takes first, you take second if reachable.

trent.primary: On our left/middle, double block with Logan. On our right, single block if you can close in time.
trent.fallback: Too late? Call no block and take short-middle; do not fake a late reach.

logan.primary: Pair with Trent to block left/middle.
logan.ifDifferent: Right attack: drop and own the short cross/cut shot instead of blocking.

harry.primary: Short tip behind the block, then turn to set the next dig.
harry.ifDifferent: If you dig first, call Georgia/Caleb for second.

georgia.primary: Own short right/line and fill centre only when the right area remains covered.

caleb.primary: Own deep middle/right and hard seam behind the blockers.
caleb.teamCall: Call MINE early on central drives.

jaz.primary: Protect manageable deep left/line, not full-court chasing.

harry.primary: Serve from behind the endline, then recover through the right lane. Do not pretend you are already front.
harry.fallback: Quick opponent return: stay on reachable right/deep ball; call another setter if you dig.

trent.primary: Front-left legal at serve contact. Read setter then close the block.

logan.primary: Front-middle legal, read their attack and join Trent on left/middle.

georgia.primary: Front-right ready for a quick overpass or tip while Harry is still running.

caleb.primary: Deep central control; leave Harry a clear return route to your right.

jaz.primary: Deep-left service-time defence, square early for driven lines.

harry.primary: Recover as far as the opponent sequence allows; only take reachable short tips.
harry.fallback: If their first return is immediate, you may still be deep; Georgia/front covers short.

trent.primary: Double with Logan for left/middle; single right only with an early read.
trent.fallback: If you cannot close right, call coverage rather than chase.

logan.primary: Block with Trent on left/middle; release to short cross-cut on right.

georgia.primary: Own short-right and line; cover fast balls while Harry returns from serve.

caleb.primary: Deeper middle/right drive and centre seam, then safe first dig.

jaz.primary: Manageable left deep/line and cross; call early.

harry.primary: Second contact normally yours after a teammate digs; follow the actual pass.
harry.ifDifferent: You made first contact: Georgia sets if reachable, Caleb alternative.

georgia.primary: Right attacking option if Harry sets.
georgia.ifDifferent: If Harry dug first, become second-contact setter; leave hitter duty to Logan/Trent.

logan.primary: Open a left approach if you did not dig first; otherwise keep a safe high-ball option.

trent.primary: Prepare a middle ball on a good pass; don't cross Harry's corridor.

harry.primary: P5 back-left in the legal receiving stack, protected from ordinary passing; move only after the serve and release directly towards the left-of-centre set.
harry.ifDifferent: If the serve drops at you, receive safely and call Georgia to set.

caleb.primary: P4 front-left: take reachable left/deep serve seam and be ready as the strongest front-left hitter.
caleb.ifDifferent: When you pass first, defer the fast approach; Trent is a safer next hitter.

trent.primary: P2 front-right: take local short-right ball, stay ready to hit right and read their setter.
trent.ifDifferent: Avoid a needless diagonal chase through Jaz.

logan.primary: P1 deep-right compact lane: support the line but don't steal centre serves.
logan.ifDifferent: Back row here, so never block.

georgia.primary: P6 deep centre: take the illustrated first pass and call the centre seam.
georgia.ifDifferent: If Harry took first contact, move for the second set rather than another dig.

jaz.primary: P3 short middle: shallow centre and tips. Only cover what you can reach.
jaz.ifDifferent: Don't play as a middle blocker or chase deep-right.

harry.primary: Avoid the normal first pass; only handle an unavoidable short/net-roll ball in your own lane. Release directly for second if a teammate passes.
harry.ifDifferent: If you passed, hold short-left cover; Georgia sets.

caleb.primary: Own deep-left and middle-left when the flight favours you; call MINE clearly.
caleb.ifDifferent: Georgia takes clear central/deep sample balls.

trent.primary: Help in short-right, keep the right hitter option open after a clean pass.

logan.primary: Compact deep-right and line. Call help early on faster seam balls.

georgia.primary: Normal example: pass deep centre high and controllably.
georgia.ifDifferent: Harry first: release to set high at centre-left.

jaz.primary: Manageable short-centre receive/tip, then defend without wide sprinting.

harry.primary: Second contact after any teammate first contact, from the reachable left-of-centre window. If YOU took the first ball, cover short and let Georgia set.
harry.ifDifferent: When you received first, Georgia takes second and Caleb can help if nearer.

caleb.primary: Open left attacking route on a clean high pass; main sample hitter.
caleb.ifDifferent: If you were first passer, call for a slower high ball.

trent.primary: Front-right real hitting alternative, not default setter.
trent.ifDifferent: If Georgia cannot get to Harry's dig, Caleb is a stronger emergency setter.

logan.primary: Hold deep-right floor and line support, not a front hitting/block position.

georgia.primary: Return to centre/deep after normal pass.
georgia.ifDifferent: Harry-first: YOU set safely, then recover; don't simultaneously claim an attack.

jaz.primary: Shallow centre attack cover or controlled safe ball, not a middle quick.

harry.primary: Cover the hitter briefly after the set, then defend short centre/left; NEVER return to an initial P5 spot just to reset.

caleb.primary: Attack from left in the example; land and prepare deep-left defence, not a return to P4 start.

trent.primary: Right-side alternative hitter and future single blocker.

logan.primary: Protect right deep and hard line when our hit comes back.

georgia.primary: Deep-middle rebound and cross-court insurance; if you just set, recover first.

jaz.primary: Cover short-centre rebound or soft tip; short movement only.

harry.primary: Short left/centre defence, protected from ordinary deep digs; once Caleb or another player digs, release directly to set the next ball.
harry.ifDifferent: If you actually dig, Georgia or Caleb takes second.

caleb.primary: Take the strongest left/deep and left-centre digs. If Trent cannot reach a quick far-left set, consider a local front-row block, but tell Georgia and Harry to shift floor lanes.
caleb.ifDifferent: For a quick left set that Trent cannot close, block locally only if truly reachable.

trent.primary: Read their attack: single-block the reachable left or right side after an early shift; on a quick far-side set take the shorter viable role and call the nearest blocker, rather than sprint across the whole net.
trent.ifDifferent: Too-fast far-left set: call NO BLOCK/Caleb early, don't teleport across court.

logan.primary: P1 back-right deep line and cross; limited but real passing area.
logan.ifDifferent: Never jump to block when back-row.

georgia.primary: Deep-middle and left-centre seam, ready for a safe first dig.

jaz.primary: Own manageable short-right tips/cuts, not a middle block or an impossible deep chase.

harry.primary: Remain P5 back-left until Logan actually serves, then defend shallow left while preserving a direct setting lane.

caleb.primary: P4 front-left: after serve, protect the left/deep and remain a later hitting option.

trent.primary: P2 front-right: read their set; you are the primary viable blocker.

logan.primary: P1 outside baseline: SERVE first, then recover into deep-right defence.
logan.ifDifferent: A fast return can arrive before you reach your ideal defensive spot.

georgia.primary: P6 middle back: read deep-centre and prepare a realistic dig.

jaz.primary: P3 front-middle: shallow-centre soft ball and tip coverage, no normal block.

harry.primary: Defend shallow left as their attack arrives. If someone else digs, set; if your own dig is necessary, call Georgia for second.

caleb.primary: Help on left/deep and preserve the middle seam while Georgia digs.

trent.primary: Recover out of the block and set up a safe right-side attack option.

logan.primary: Back-right line coverage after serving; avoid leaving the corner exposed.

georgia.primary: Take the sample driven dig from left-centre and pass high to Harry.
georgia.ifDifferent: If Harry takes first, YOU set the second, Caleb backs you up.

jaz.primary: Short-centre tip and easy ball; don't chase deep crosscourt.

harry.primary: Second contact after any teammate first contact, from the reachable left-of-centre window. If YOU took the first ball, cover short and let Georgia set.
harry.ifDifferent: Harry first: Georgia sets and you protect short-left.

caleb.primary: Approach from front-left when you did not take the dig.
caleb.ifDifferent: If emergency second contact falls to you, Trent becomes the main hitter.

trent.primary: Real right hitter with a high safe pass, NOT the routine second setter.

logan.primary: Stay in deep-right defence; no fake front-row attack.

georgia.primary: Normal dig: recover from pass to deep middle.
georgia.ifDifferent: Harry-first: move into second set, then recover naturally.

jaz.primary: Hold short central attack cover and give a calm safe option.

harry.primary: Cover the hitter briefly after the set, then defend short centre/left; NEVER return to an initial P5 spot just to reset.

caleb.primary: Main left hitter, then return to deep-left responsibility for their next attack.

trent.primary: Right hitter alternative and single-block defender on next read.

logan.primary: Cover the right/deep line, especially on their fast counterattack.

georgia.primary: Cover deep centre and cross seam; no unnecessary chase to the net.

jaz.primary: Own short centre/tips and protect the hitter's rebound.

harry.primary: Short left/centre defence, protected from ordinary deep digs; once Caleb or another player digs, release directly to set the next ball.
harry.ifDifferent: If you dig, Georgia or Caleb becomes setter.

caleb.primary: Take the strongest left/deep and left-centre digs. If Trent cannot reach a quick far-left set, consider a local front-row block, but tell Georgia and Harry to shift floor lanes.

logan.primary: Recover after serving to narrow deep-right/line support.

georgia.primary: Middle/deep helper, cover seam while Caleb owns the next dig.

jaz.primary: Own manageable short-right tips/cuts, not a middle block or an impossible deep chase.
